title: What the Multi-Tenant Portal Tenants page lists and filters, and how tenant groups are created and assigned a policy template

prose.label: Tenant list.
prose.text: {{tenants-columns}} Whether the column shows one template or several for a tenant that has both a direct and a group template is not stated {{gap:template-column-multiple}}. {{tenants-filters}}

tenants-columns.statement: The Tenants page lists, for each tenant, an Organization ID, a Customer ID, a Policy Template column (described as "the policy templates the tenant is provisioned") and the group the tenant belongs to.

quotes: Organization ID: The ID assigned to the tenant.
Customer ID: The ID assigned to the customer.
Policy Template: The policy templates the tenant is provisioned.
Tenant Group: The group the tenant belongs to.

tenants-filters.statement: The Tenants page can filter tenants by the cloud they are provisioned on, show tenants with disabled accounts, and filter and search by customer name, customer ID, tenant name or domain, or organization ID.

quotes: Filter to view the tenants based on the cloud they are provisioned on.
Filter and search for tenants based on the customer name, customer ID, tenant name or domain, or organization ID.

groups-purpose.statement: Tenant groups group tenants across clouds and industries to ease tenant management and can be assigned to admin users.

quotes: you can group tenants across clouds and industries. This feature facilitates easy tenant management as well as policy deployment to multiple tenants across clouds.
Assign tenant groups to admin users for easy tenant management.

group-one-template.statement: A tenant group can only be provisioned in one policy template.

quotes: A group can only be provisioned in one policy template.

groups-permission.statement: Only an admin with permission to manage tenants can create, view or modify tenant groups.

quotes: Only an admin with permission to manage tenants can create, view, or modify tenant groups.

group-create-fields.statement: A tenant group is created with a Name, a Cloud, Tenants selected from the cloud, and an optional Description.

quotes: Name: Enter a name for the group.
Tenants: Select tenants from the cloud.
Description: Add a description, if you want.

group-status.statement: The tenant group details page shows each tenant's status as Active or Disabled.

quotes: Status: The tenant's status (Active or Disabled).

group-assign-template.statement: A policy template is assigned to a tenant group by adding the group under Tenant Groups in the Edit Policy Template window, then clicking Save and Sync.

quotes: In the Edit Policy Template window, add the tenant group under Tenant Groups.

template-column-multiple.title: How the Tenants page Policy Template column shows a tenant with more than one template
template-column-multiple.detail: The Tenants article describes the Policy Template column as the policy templates the tenant is provisioned, while the policy template article says a tenant or tenant group can be associated to only one policy template; neither says what the column shows for a tenant with a direct template and a tenant-group template.
